5.3 Disconnection Times and Earth Fault Loop Impedance
UK DOMESTIC ELECTRICAL JOB QUOTING - FOUNDATIONAL KNOWLEDGE BASE

rows.Characteristics: Combined neutral and earth (PEN conductor); earth bonded to neutral at cut-out; most common UK supply
rows.Key Quoting Implications: Standard 10mm² main bonding; Type 2 SPD recommended; cannot export PME earth to outbuildings with showers

rows.Characteristics: Separate earth conductor (typically lead cable sheath); no neutral-earth connection at cut-out
rows.Key Quoting Implications: 6mm² minimum bonding; increasingly rare; may require supply upgrade if adding high-load circuits

rows.Characteristics: Local earth electrode (copper rod); no supply earth connection; earth resistance critical
rows.Key Quoting Implications: 30mA RCD mandatory on all circuits; earth electrode required; Type 2 SPD typically mandatory; RCD may nuisance trip
